messages:
olivia-se: Quick heads-up 4 Cedar Health Systems (enterprise payer) wants Net120 on a 4-year Dedicated commitment. They're asking for a 40% discount and want invoicing: 30% of Y1 at signing, remaining Y1 + Y2-Y4 invoiced annually Net120. POC and security review done. Can deal-desk + finance + legal weigh in?

marc-deal: Need list pricing, pool size, and confirm Dedicated. Also any credit history?

olivia-se: Dedicated reserved pool. List = $600,000/yr. 40% off => $360k/yr, total $1.44M over 4 years. Upfront requested = 30% of Y1 = $108k. They will provide a PO from procurement. Credit check initiated but not complete.

tina-finance: Standard is Net30. Net120 is a high risk exception. Two immediate asks: 1) completed credit check and any trade references? 2) payment method (ACH/wire vs vendor AP check) and vendor onboarding status? Also need CFO/billing contact.

olivia-se: Credit check in progress; CFO (payments@cedarhealth.org) says AP will only approve Net120 to smooth operating budgets and will pay via ACH once vendor onboarding completes. They canprovide trade ref.

jorge-legal: If we accept Net120, we need a payment addendum: late interest, invoice references, suspension clause (service suspend after X days), and requirement for PO# on every invoice. For a multi-year deal we should also add a termination-for-nonpayment clause and require an annual renewal acknowledgement. I'll draft an addendum.

marc-deal: Deal-desk proposal: Approve 40% discount only if customer provides either (A) 60% of total contract value collected upfront, OR (B) an irrevocable Letter of Credit (LC) covering the unpaid balance. Otherwise cap discount at 25% and Net60 max. Thoughts?

olivia-se: Customer will not provide 60% upfront and says LC is a non-starter for them. Theyare firm on Net120 and only willing to do 30% upfront.

tina-finance: Finance can consider a middle-ground: provisionally approve 35% discount if these exact conditions are met: - 30% of Y1 paid upfront and clears before provisioning - Completed credit check with acceptable score and trade refs verified - Signed SOW + PO within 7 business days - Customer executes payment security instrument: either an LC for years 2-4 or an escrow agreement where year2-4 funds are pre-authorized to be wired within 30 days of each anniversary. If any of these fail, fallback is 25% discount + Net60.

marc-deal: I'll enter those as hard conditions on the opportunity: "35% discount conditional on 30% Y1 upfront cleared + PO within 7bd + credit pass + LC or escrow for remaining years; else 25% + Net60." Legal to add late fee and suspension language per @jorge.

billing-bot: Draft invoice created INV-1903-0004

Invoice: INV-1903-0004
Customer: Cedar Health Systems
Amount: $108,000 (30% of Y1)  due on receipt
Schedule: Remaining Year1 + Year2-Year4 invoiced annually Net120
Notes: 35% discount approval conditional on cleared upfront payment + PO + credit pass + LC/escrow for remaining years

arun-sre: Hold provisioning until finance confirms cleared funds. Need final reserved pool spec (estimated 6xA100 equivalent). Also need model pin/version.

olivia-se: I'll push PO and payment instructions today and confirm whether they can do escrow or an LC. I'll update the thread when wire/escrow is in place. Looping in @marc-deal @tina-finance @jorge-legal. :thumbsup:

marc-deal: Added to deal desk queue. Finance to create credit-check ticket. Legal to prepare addendum and SOW invoice schedule.

tina-finance: Noted. Once upfront clears and LC/escrow confirmed, finance will authorize provisioning and release invoices schedule. Remittance will go to billing@redwood.com.

olivia-se: Closing loop 4 customer agreed to explore escrow option and will get back by COB.
